arStrings.szText: The four lesser evils {c_highlight}Azmodan{/c},  {c_highlight}Duriel{/c},  {c_highlight}Belial{/c}, and  {c_highlight}Andariel{/c} have invaded sanctuary. Defeat them to uncover {c_highlight}Corrupted Essences{/c}.
Slay them and return their Corrupted Essences to {c_highlight}Hadriel{/c} to uncover {c_highlight}Divine Gifts{/c}.
{icon:DivinePower_Corrupted, 2.} {c_highlight}Corrupted Gifts{/c} amplify your rewards, while warping the challenge into something more perilous.
{icon:DivinePower_Purified, 2.} {c_highlight}Purified Gifts{/c} offer the full reward with no drawbacks.
